Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		productCatalog: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isNewCatalog: Boolean = if productCatalog.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->isUnique(o: ProductCatalog|o.Id)
	postcondition:
		if isNewCatalog 
		then let newProductCatalog: ProductCatalog in
		newProductCatalog.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newProductCatalog) and
		newProductCatalog.Id = id and
		newProductCatalog.Name = name and
		result = isNewCatalog 
		else result = isNewCatalog 
		endif 
}
